title: scenario/0 - events and what they must leave
description: A scenario of a machine: the events and, after every step, the expected state, structural journal (the lines the machine wrote), a subset of the data, the queue, the open requests, the requests sent and cancelled, the outcome. A part that is not named is not compared. The runner is src/machine_run/scenario.nv.

machine.description: the Latin name of the machine the scenario runs on

start_at.description: the clock of the in-memory world in milliseconds

standalone.description: the machine runs alone (task 122): its parties of the kind `machine` are played by the steps of the scenario (an `answer` or a `failure` event with the id of the request, as for an agent); no nested machine is started and none is looked for in the folder

params.description: the table of the parameters of the project (format 2.7, P-9): the key `проект.<ключ>` of the column "project override" of a parameter and its value in the lossless JSON form of the core; a key the machine does not have refuses the run, a parameter that is not named keeps its default

name.description: required for signal and progress; the defaults are answer, failure, timeout, start

party.description: for a signal: the name of the party that declared it (the owner of a party signal, format 2.13, AL-38); a party that does not declare the signal is a mistake of the scenario; absent: the signal is looked for in the parties and then in the signals of the machine

at.description: the stamp of the event in milliseconds of the epoch (AL-134, Alula 2.25): the clock of the world is set to it before the event is accepted; `event.at` of the machine reads it; absent: the clock of the world as it is (start_at and the steps advance)

request.description: the id of the request the event answers (agent-1); for `start` the id of the request that started the machine (the request of the call)

input.description: the data of the event: a signal with one field has the value of the field (a text, `"ivan"`, not an object), with several fields an object {field: value}, with none no input; the input of the start is an object (format 2.7, P-8)

code.description: the failure code of a `failure` event (ModelRefused)

source.description: the key of the source of the event: the engine acknowledges it after the commit

data.description: the names of data and their values in the JSON form of the core

queue.description: send <id> and cancel <id> that wait for the dispatch, in <name> that wait for the pump

sent.description: all the requests sent so far

cancelled.description: all the requests cancelled so far

event.description: required for feed, accept and deliver

host.description: answers of primitives of the host that hold from this step on: the name of the primitive and its value in the lossless JSON form of the core

expect.description: what the engine the step acts on must leave

on.description: the id of the request of a nested machine (callee-1) that the step acts on; the parent when absent. The nested machines start when the parent sends their request, answer the parent when they end, get a signal for a signal of the parent and a cancel for a cancelled request (src/machine_run/nested.nv)

also.description: what other engines must leave after the step: the key is `parent` or the id of the request of a nested machine
